providers.operation: Advance all three models once with complete gradients, Adam and explicit EMA observations.

parameters.state: Shared integer step and exactly three model dictionaries containing named parameters, optimizer and EMA.
parameters.batches: Exactly three source model batches with x,y,previous,mean,std,truth and optional dropout masks.
parameters.observations: Exactly three dictionaries: parameter_phase before/after and observed global_step equal to current or next shared step.

providers.validity_bounds: Preserve ten named parameter tensors, width267 GRU forward/loss, autograd, global-norm clipping10, float32 Adam rate.001/betas.9,.999/epsilon-hat1e-8 and EMA min(.99,(1+observed_step)/(10+observed_step)). Return new state; inputs unchanged. Invalid/nonfinite optimization state rejects.
providers.outputs: Updated shared-step/models dictionary and three metric dictionaries.
providers.plain_limits: Perform one complete training update for each model.
providers.reuse: Three-model s32 update policy with explicit observations; numeric lower-level helpers remain independently implemented.

providers.validity_bounds: Require more than409 input days, at least one possible training window passing completeness, and a schedule with saved checkpoints. Positive batch/epoch counts, nonnegative step thresholds, seed<=2**32-4, completeness[0,1], explicit before/after EMA phases. RuntimeConfig is frozen but nested data must remain caller-stable.

providers.operation: Weighted neighboring-lag correlations and population standardization.

parameters.starts: Aligned integer first support positions in[-1,width).
parameters.ends: Aligned integer final support positions in[-1,width), not before starts; paired -1 marks no support.
parameters.thresholds: Aligned nonnegative finite Python numeric support thresholds excluding bool.

providers.validity_bounds: Preserve source exclusive end slicing even though support endpoint is the last positive position. Support length/lag must be strictly greater than threshold. Correlation is .5 at lag plus .25 at each neighboring lag. Undefined correlations become zero before population standardization. Constant populations can return NaN; no repair or finite-output guarantee.
providers.outputs: float64 entity-by-lag matrix in requested order.
providers.plain_limits: Summarize lagged similarity using explicit offsets and support thresholds.
providers.reuse: Domain-independent numeric panel operation; no page or date semantics.

Nineteen providers expose complete preparation, feature blocks, three-model training with callable updates and checkpoint retention, prediction and aligned output. Numeric correlations, normalization and suffix alignment are independently reusable; recipe assumptions are explicit. Original, derivative and provider histories are preserved.
